figurative_meaning_en: An imaginary place of happiness or fool's paradise
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গজদন্তমিনারে বাস করছে, বাস্তবতা থেকে বিচ্ছিন্ন হয়ে।
এই স্বপ্ন গজদন্তমিনারের মতো, কখনো সত্যি হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is living in an ivory tower, detached from reality.
This dream is like a fool's paradise; it will never come true.
note: This idiom draws from the concept of an unreal, luxurious isolation, akin to Western 'ivory tower' but with a Bengali twist emphasizing folly.
